nl.title: Hoe meet ik of mijn AI-agents resultaat opleveren?
nl.excerpt: Hoe meet ik of mijn AI-agents resultaat opleveren: praktische handleiding in AI-agents, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
AI-agents meten zichzelf niet als omzet. Jij koppelt Tasks completed en status aan businessmetrics.

Meetlagen

  • Agentlaag — status, last active, tasks completed.
  • Kanaallaag — verkeer, leads, chatvragen, campagneresultaten.
  • Businesslaag — offertes, orders, afspraken.

Eenvoudig ritme

  1. Kies 1–3 KPI’s per agent.
  2. Review wekelijks 15 minuten.
  3. Herhaal AI-scan of Search Console-check maandelijks.
  4. Stop of wissel type als er 4 weken geen beweging is én geen blokkade.

Tip: Schrijf KPI’s op in het project in het CRM — dan blijft het team aligned.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld je pakketnaam, agenttype en status, zodat we sneller kunnen helpen.

Gerelateerd: Analytics-agent; geschikte taken.

en.title: How do I measure whether my AI agents deliver results?
en.excerpt: How do I measure whether my AI agents deliver results: steps in the AI-scan / agent dashboard for measure, whether, agents.
en.bodyHtml:
For How do I measure whether my AI agents deliver results follow a targeted checklist in the AI-scan / agent dashboard. Core themes: measure, whether, agents.

Preparation

  • Access to the AI-scan / agent dashboard
  • Focus of this article: measure, whether, agents
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Work in the AI-scan / agent dashboard. Stay on the topic measure, whether, agents — no parallel experiments.
  2. Open the AI scan or agent/workflow in the portal.
  3. Check input (URL, trigger, credentials) for measure.
  4. Run the scan or dry-run; read scores/logs around whether.
  5. Apply targeted fixes and retest.
  6. Document what you changed around measure, whether, agents (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for measure, whether, agents matches “How do I measure whether my AI agents deliver results”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside measure whether agents
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get measure, whether, agents right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if measure, whether, agents touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: the AI-scan / agent dashboard, backups, tickets.
